neighbours.label: a rank or position in an ordered series, especially the second ('2nd class', 'game 2', 'second place', each 'level')
fire: She received the Order of Merit, 2nd class, for her service.
The champions lost game 2 of the series in overtime.
In the end, our team took second place in the regional final.
He became the 2nd Earl of Derby after his father died.
Players unlock the 2nd level after collecting ten keys.
Her horse finished second in the third race of the day.
Chapter 2 of the textbook covers the Roman republic.
The 2nd round of voting will take place next Sunday.
quiet: She received a medal and a letter for her service.
The champions scored 2 goals in overtime.
In the end, our team bought two buses for the regional final.
He inherited 2 farms after his father died.
Players need to collect 2 keys to open the gate.
Her horse waited a second before jumping the fence.
Two chapters of the textbook cover the Roman republic.
The voting will take place in 2 cities next Sunday.

predictions: Fires on 2nd/second/game 2 when they mark a place in a sequence or ranking; quiet on the same numbers as counts and 'second' as time.
notes: Probes: '(2nd class)' 0.50 (peak ' class'), 'game 2 of a best-of-three' 0.45, 'Each level' 0.29, '2nd Duke' 0.21, 'second place' 0.21; '2 apples' 0.008; '1st session' only 0.06, so 'first' is weaker than 'second'. Median may be near 0.2.
